newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures end with strong gains.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures end with strong gains.

text.p: Dec 24 - U.S. stock index futures closed with strong gains and at the peaks of the day. Futures drifted up during the morning of the holiday-shortened session, garnering some strength from firmness in OTC stocks and the penetration of minor resistance near 756.00 in March S&P 500s. Buying picked up after the close of cash stocks in the last 15 minutes in thin trade.
